subject: Decision Making
title: Nudging for Sustainability
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Nudging for Sustainability.

hook.text: Making double-sided printing the default in a university saved 44 million sheets of paper in one semester.

buildup.text: Green nudges reduce environmental harm without banning anything. Smaller plates in buffets cut food waste by 20%.

discovery.text: Green energy defaults increased renewable adoption by 90% in German towns. People could switch back. Almost nobody did.

twist.text: Carbon footprint labels on food shifted purchases toward lower-emission options by 6%.

climax.text: Sustainability nudges prove that small design changes at scale produce massive environmental benefits without coercion.

punchline.text: Default to double-sided. 44 million sheets saved in one semester.

quiz.question: How did changing the default printer setting help the environment?
options: Defaulting to double-sided printing saved 44 million sheets in one semester
